WITH s AS (
  SELECT abs_diffsel AS v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY abs_diffsel) - 1 AS i, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM data
),
q AS (
  SELECT
    -- Q1 at pos 0.25*(n-1)
    (SELECT CASE WHEN 0.25*(n-1) = CAST(0.25*(n-1) AS INT) THEN v
       ELSE v + (0.25*(n-1) - CAST(0.25*(n-1) AS INT)) * (
          (SELECT v FROM s WHERE i = CAST(0.25*(n-1) AS INT)+1) - v)
       END FROM s WHERE i = CAST(0.25*(n-1) AS INT)) AS q1,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN 0.75*(n-1) = CAST(0.75*(n-1) AS INT) THEN v
       ELSE v + (0.75*(n-1) - CAST(0.75*(n-1) AS INT)) * (
          (SELECT v FROM s WHERE i = CAST(0.75*(n-1) AS INT)+1) - v)
       END FROM s WHERE i = CAST(0.75*(n-1) AS INT)) AS q3,
    (SELECT MAX(n) FROM s) AS n
)
SELECT q1, q3, q3-q1 AS iqr, q1-1.5*(q3-q1) AS lo, q3+1.5*(q3-q1) AS hi FROM q

WITH s AS (
  SELECT abs_diffsel AS v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY abs_diffsel) - 1 AS i, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM data
),
q AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT CASE WHEN 0.25*(n-1) = CAST(0.25*(n-1) AS INT) THEN v
       ELSE v + (0.25*(n-1) - CAST(0.25*(n-1) AS INT)) * ((SELECT v FROM s WHERE i = CAST(0.25*(n-1) AS INT)+1) - v)
       END FROM s WHERE i = CAST(0.25*(n-1) AS INT)) AS q1,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN 0.75*(n-1) = CAST(0.75*(n-1) AS INT) THEN v
       ELSE v + (0.75*(n-1) - CAST(0.75*(n-1) AS INT)) * ((SELECT v FROM s WHERE i = CAST(0.75*(n-1) AS INT)+1) - v)
       END FROM s WHERE i = CAST(0.75*(n-1) AS INT)) AS q3
)
SELECT d.site, d.abs_diffsel,
  CASE WHEN d.abs_diffsel < q.q1-1.5*(q.q3-q.q1) THEN 'low'
       WHEN d.abs_diffsel > q.q3+1.5*(q.q3-q.q1) THEN 'high' END AS dir
FROM data d, q
WHERE d.abs_diffsel < q.q1-1.5*(q.q3-q.q1) OR d.abs_diffsel > q.q3+1.5*(q.q3-q.q1)

WITH s AS (SELECT country, gdpPercap_1982 AS v FROM data),
q AS (SELECT
 (SELECT v FROM s ORDER BY v LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST((COUNT(*)-1)*0.25 AS INT) FROM s)) AS q1,

task_contract.question: Perform comprehensive data preprocessing on the abalone dataset. Handle any missing values and scale the variables (length, diameter, height, whole weight, shucked weight, viscera weight, shell weight) using min-max normalization. Then, perform a distribution analysis to determine if the scaled variables adhere to a normal distribution.

trace.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Length IS NULL OR Diameter IS NULL OR Height IS NULL OR "Whole weight" IS NULL OR "Shucked weight" IS NULL OR "Viscera weight" IS NULL OR "Shell weight" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_rows
FROM data

WITH stats AS (
 SELECT 'Length' c, COUNT(*) n, AVG(Length) m FROM data WHERE Length IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Diameter', COUNT(*), AVG(Diameter) FROM data WHERE Diameter IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Height', COUNT(*), AVG(Height) FROM data WHERE Height IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Whole weight', COUNT(*), AVG("Whole weight") FROM data WHERE "Whole weight" IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Shucked weight', COUNT(*), AVG("Shucked weight") FROM data WHERE "Shucked weight" IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Viscera weight', COUNT(*), AVG("Viscera weight") FROM data WHERE "Viscera weight" IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Shell weight', COUNT(*), AVG("Shell weight") FROM data WHERE "Shell weight" IS NOT NULL
),
ms AS (
 SELECT s.c, s.n, s.m,
  (SELECT AVG(power(d.x - s.m,3)) FROM (SELECT CASE s.c WHEN 'Length' THEN Length WHEN 'Diameter' THEN Diameter WHEN 'Height' THEN Height WHEN 'Whole weight' THEN "Whole weight" WHEN 'Shucked weight' THEN "Shucked weight" WHEN 'Viscera weight' THEN "Viscera weight" ELSE "Shell weight" END x FROM data) d WHERE d.x IS NOT NULL) m3,
  (SELECT AVG(power(d.x - s.m,4)) FROM (SELECT CASE s.c WHEN 'Length' THEN Length WHEN 'Diameter' THEN Diameter WHEN 'Height' THEN Height WHEN 'Whole weight' THEN "Whole weight" WHEN 'Shucked weight' THEN "Shucked weight" WHEN 'Viscera weight' THEN "Viscera weight" ELSE "Shell weight" END x FROM data) d WHERE d.x IS NOT NULL) m4,
  (SELECT AVG(power(d.x - s.m,2)) FROM (SELECT CASE s.c WHEN 'Length' THEN Length WHEN 'Diameter' THEN Diameter WHEN 'Height' THEN Height WHEN 'Whole weight' THEN "Whole weight" WHEN 'Shucked weight' THEN "Shucked weight" WHEN 'Viscera weight' THEN "Viscera weight" ELSE "Shell weight" END x FROM data) d WHERE d.x IS NOT NULL) m2
 FROM stats s
)
SELECT c, n, ROUND(m3/power(m2,1.5),4) AS skew, ROUND(m4/power(m2,2)-3,4) AS exkurt
FROM ms

task_contract.question: Identify and remove any outliers in the MedInc column of the provided dataset using the IQR method. Then calculate the mean and standard deviation of the cleaned MedInc column.
task_contract.public_requirements:
Identify an outlier as any value that falls below Q1 - 1.5 * IQR or above Q3 + 1.5 * IQR, where Q1 and Q3 are the first and third quartiles, respectively, and IQR is the interquartile range (Q3 - Q1). Calculate the mean and standard deviation to two decimal places.
@mean[mean_value] where "mean_value" is a float rounded to two decimal places. @standard_deviation[standard_deviation_value] where "standard_deviation_value" is a float rounded to two decimal places.

trace.sql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(MedInc) AS mean_all,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM data
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT MedInc FROM data ORDER BY MedInc LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST((COUNT(*)-1)/4 AS INT) FROM data)) AS q1a,
    (SELECT MedInc FROM data ORDER BY MedInc LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(3*(COUNT(*)-1)/4 AS INT) FROM data)) AS q3a
  FROM data LIMIT 1
)
SELECT q1a, q3a, q1a - 1.5*(q3a-q1a) AS lo, q3a + 1.5*(q3a-q1a) AS hi FROM bounds

WITH b AS (
  SELECT 2.6402 AS q1, 5.0151 AS q3
),
lo_hi AS (
  SELECT q1 - 1.5*(q3-q1) AS lo, q3 + 1.5*(q3-q1) AS hi FROM b
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(d.MedInc), 2) AS mean,
  ROUND(SQRT(SUM((d.MedInc - (SELECT AVG(MedInc) FROM data WHERE MedInc >= lo AND MedInc <= hi))*(d.MedInc - (SELECT AVG(MedInc) FROM data WHERE MedInc >= lo AND MedInc <= hi)))/(COUNT(*)-1)), 2) AS standard_deviation
FROM data d, lo_hi
WHERE d.MedInc >= lo_hi.lo AND d.MedInc <= lo_hi.hi

task_contract.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
task_contract.public_requirements: Increase or Decrease = consumption for 2013 - consumption for 2012; Percentage of Increase = (Increase or Decrease / consumption for 2013) * 100%; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year

results.final_sql:
WITH y AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS seg,
         CAST(substr(ym.Date,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
         ym.Consumption AS cons
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
    AND substr(ym.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT seg,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2012 THEN cons END) AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yr=2013 THEN cons END) AS c2013
  FROM y
  GROUP BY seg
),
pct AS (
  SELECT seg, c2012, c2013,
         1.0*(c2013-c2012)/NULLIF(c2013,0)*100 AS pct_increase,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY 1.0*(c2013-c2012)/NULLIF(c2013,0)*100 DESC) AS r_desc,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY 1.0*(c2013-c2012)/NULLIF(c2013,0)*100 ASC) AS r_asc
  FROM agg
)
SELECT seg, c2012, c2013, pct_increase,
       CASE WHEN r_desc=1 THEN 'biggest' ELSE 'lowest' END AS which
FROM pct
WHERE r_desc=1 OR r_asc=1
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

  FROM q

mom AS (

WITH sorted AS (
  SELECT MedInc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MedInc) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM data WHERE MedInc IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  (SELECT MedInc FROM sorted WHERE rn = (SELECT MIN(rn) FROM sorted WHERE 4*rn >= n)) AS q1_pt,
  1

WITH s AS (
  SELECT MedInc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MedInc) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM data WHERE MedInc IS NOT NULL
),
f AS (SELECT (n-1) AS nm1 FROM s WHERE rn=1),
q1 AS (
  SELECT (SELECT MedInc FROM s WHERE rn = CAST(0.25*nm1 AS INTEGER)+1)
       + (0.25*nm1 - CAST(0.25*nm1 AS INTEGER)) *
         ((SELECT MedInc FROM s WHERE rn = CAST(0.25*nm1 AS INTEGER)+2)
          - (SELECT MedInc FROM s WHERE rn = CAST(0.25*nm1 AS INTEGER)+1)) AS val
  FROM f
),
q3 AS (
  SELECT (SELECT MedInc FROM s WHERE rn = CAST(0.75*nm1 AS INTEGER)+1)
       + (0.75*nm1 - CAST(0.75*nm1 AS INTEGER)) *
         ((SELECT MedInc FROM s WHERE rn = CAST(0.75*nm1 AS INTEGER)+2)
          - (SELECT MedInc FROM s WHERE rn = CAST(0.75*nm1 AS INTEGER)+1)) AS val
  FROM f
),
b AS (SELECT q1.val AS q1, q3.val AS q3, (q3.val-q1.val) AS iqr FROM q1,q3),
clean AS (
  SELECT d.MedInc AS v FROM data d, b
  WHERE d.MedInc IS NOT NULL
    AND d.MedInc >= b.q1 - 1.5*b.iqr
    AND d.MedInc <= b.q3 + 1.5*b.iqr
),
m AS (SELECT AVG(v) AS mu FROM clean)
SELECT
  ROUND((SELECT mu FROM m), 2) AS mean,
  ROUND(SQRT(SUM((v-(SELECT mu FROM m))*(v-(SELECT mu FROM m)))/(COUNT(*)-1)), 2) AS standard_deviation
FROM clean

WITH dedup AS (SELECT * FROM data GROUP BY TRUE_TIME, TIME, USFLUX, MEANGAM, MEANGBT, MEANGBZ, MEANGBH, MEANJZD, TOTUSJZ, MEANJZH, TOTUSJH, ABSNJZH, SAVNCPP, MEANPOT, TOTPOT, MEANSHR, SHRGT45, R_VALUE, AREA_ACR),
filled AS (SELECT COALESCE(USFLUX, (SELECT AVG(USFLUX) FROM dedup)) AS USFLUX, MEANJZH, TOTUSJZ, TRUE_TIME, TIME FROM dedup),
norm AS (SELECT USFLUX, MEANJZH, TOTUSJZ,
  (TOTUSJZ - MIN(TOTUSJZ) OVER ()) / (MAX(TOTUSJZ) OVER () - MIN(TOTUSJZ) OVER ()) AS normz,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TIME, TRUE_TIME) AS rn
  FROM filled)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dedup) AS clean_entries,
  (SELECT AVG(USFLUX) FROM filled) AS mean_usflux,
  (SELECT ROUND(LOG10(MEANJZH + 1e-10),3) FROM norm WHERE rn=1) AS log_MEANJZH,
  (SELECT ROUND(normz,3) FROM norm WHERE rn=1) AS norm_TOTUSJZ,

task_contract.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
task_contract.public_requirements: Increase or Decrease = consumption for 2013 - consumption for 2012; Percentage of Increase = (Increase or Decrease / consumption for 2013) * 100%; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year

results.final_sql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency='EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
    AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT segment, cons_2012, cons_2013,
         1.0*(cons_2013-cons_2012)/NULLIF(cons_2012,0)*100 AS pct_increase
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  (SELECT segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_segment,
  (SELECT pct_increase FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_pct,
  (SELECT segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_segment,
  (SELECT pct_increase FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_pct

  FROM yearmonth y

  WHERE c.Currency='EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
    AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')

         SUM(Age*Age)*1.0 saa, SUM(Pclass*Pclass)*1.0 spp, SUM(Age*Pclass)*1.0 sap,
         SUM(Age*Fare)*1.0 saf, SUM(Pclass*Fare)*1.0 spf
  FROM data
),
g AS (
  SELECT n, saa - sa*sa/n AS Caa, spp - sp*sp/n AS Cpp, sap - sa*sp/n AS Cap,
         saf - sa*sf/n AS Caf, spf - sp*sf/n AS Cpf, sf/n AS mf, sa/n AS ma, sp/n AS mp FROM m
),
b AS (
  SELECT (Caf*Cpp - Cpf*Cap)/(Caa*Cpp - Cap*Cap) AS b_age,
         (Cpf*Caa - Caf*Cap)/(Caa*Cpp - Cap*Cap) AS b_pclass,
         mf - (Caf*Cpp - Cpf*Cap)/(Caa*Cpp - Cap*Cap)*ma - (Cpf*Caa - Caf*Cap)/(Caa*Cpp - Cap*Cap)*mp AS b0,
         Caa, Cpp, Cap, n FROM g
),
s AS (
  SELECT SUM((Fare - (b0 + b_age*Age + b_pclass*Pclass))*(Fare - (b0 + b_age*Age + b_pclass*Pclass))) AS SSE,
         b_age, b_pclass, b0, Caa, Cpp, Cap, n FROM data, b
),
v AS (
  SELECT b_age, b_pclass, n, (SSE/(n-3))*Cpp/(Caa*Cpp-Cap*Cap) AS va, (SSE/(n-3))*Caa/(Caa*Cpp-Cap*Cap) AS vp FROM s
)
SELECT
  ROUND(b_age, 2) AS coef_age,
  ROUND(b_pclass, 2) AS coef_pclass,
  CASE WHEN (b_age/sqrt(va)) < 0 THEN 'significant'
       WHEN (b_age/sqrt(va)) > 0 AND abs(b_age/sqrt(va)) > 0 THEN
         CASE WHEN abs(b_age/sqrt(va)) >= 0 AND 0 = 1 THEN 'x' END END AS relationship_age,
  b_pclass AS relationship_pclass
FROM v

m3 AS (SELECT AVG((d.L-mL.a)*(d.L-mL.a)*(d.L-mL.a)) l3, AVG((d.D-mL.b)*(d.D-mL.b)*(d.D-mL.b)) d3, AVG((d.H-mL.c)*(d.H-mL.c)*(d.H-mL.c)) h3, AVG((d.W-mL.e)*(d.W-mL.e)*(d.W-mL.e)) w3, AVG((d.S-mL.f)*(d.S-mL.f)*(d.S-mL.f)) s3, AVG((d.V-mL.g)*(d.V-mL.g)*(d.V-mL.g)) v3, AVG((d.Sh-mL.h)*(d.Sh-mL.h)*(d.Sh-mL.h)) sh3 FROM d, mL),
m4 AS (SELECT AVG((d.L-mL.a)*(d.L-mL.a)*(d.L-mL.a)*(d.L-mL.a)) l4, AVG((d.D-mL.b)*(d.D-mL.b)*(d.D-mL.b)*(d.D-mL.b)) d4, AVG((d.H-mL.c)*(d.H-mL.c)*(d.H-mL.c)*(d.H-mL.c)) h4, AVG((d.W-mL.e)*(d.W-mL.e)*(d.W-mL.e)*(d.W-mL.e)) w4, AVG((d.S-mL.f)*(d.S-mL.f)*(d.S-mL.f)*(d.S-mL.f)) s4, AVG((d.V-mL.g)*(d.V-mL.g)*(d.V-mL.g)*(d.V-mL.g)) v4, AVG((d.Sh-mL.h)*(d.Sh-mL.h)*(d.Sh-mL.h)*(d.Sh-mL.h)) sh4 FROM d, mL)

WITH r AS (
  SELECT MedInc, (RANK() OVER (ORDER BY MedInc) - 1) * 1.0 / (COUNT(*) OVER () - 1) AS pct, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM data
),
q AS (
  SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN pct <= 0.25 THEN MedInc END) AS q1,
         MAX(CASE WHEN pct <= 0.75 THEN MedInc END) AS q3
  FROM r
),
b AS (
  SELECT q1, q3, (q3 - q1) AS iqr,
         q1 - 1.5*(q3-q1) AS lo, q3 + 1.5*(q3-q1) AS hi
  FROM q
),
clean AS (
  SELECT d.MedInc FROM data d, b WHERE d.MedInc >= b.lo AND d.MedInc <= b.hi
)
SELECT b.q1, b.q3, b.lo, b.hi, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clean) AS nc,
       ROUND((SELECT AVG(MedInc) FROM clean),2) AS mean,
       ROUND((SELECT SQRT(SUM((MedInc - (SELECT AVG(MedInc) FROM clean))*(MedInc - (SELECT AVG(MedInc) FROM clean)))/(COUNT(*)-1)) FROM clean),2) AS standard_deviation
FROM b

WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT "Economy (GDP per Capita)" AS x, "Health (Life Expectancy)" AS y
  FROM data
  WHERE x IS NOT NULL AND y IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    (AVG(x*y) - AVG(x)*AVG(y)) as sxy,
    (AVG(x*x) - AVG(x)*AVG(x)) as sxx,
    (AVG(y*y) - AVG(y)*AVG(y)) as syy
  FROM pairs
)
SELECT sxy*sxy/(sxx*syy) AS r_squared FROM stats

WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT "Economy (GDP per Capita)" AS x, "Health (Life Expectancy)" AS y
  FROM data
  WHERE x IS NOT NULL AND y IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    (AVG(x*y) - AVG(x)*AVG(y)) as sxy,
    (AVG(x*x) - AVG(x)*AVG(x)) as sxx,
    (AVG(y*y) - AVG(y)*AVG(y)) as syy
  FROM pairs
)
SELECT
  ROUND(sxy*sxy/(sxx*syy), 2) AS coefficient_determination,
  CASE WHEN sxy*sxy/(sxx*syy) >= 0.7 THEN 'good fit' ELSE 'poor fit' END AS model_fit
FROM stats

task_contract.question:
Perform comprehensive data preprocessing for the dataset by:
1. Removing any duplicate entries.
2. Filling in missing values in the USFLUX column with the mean value of the column.
3. Transforming the MEANJZH column by applying the logarithm function (base 10).
4. Normalizing the TOTUSJZ column using Min-Max normalization.
task_contract.public_requirements:
When applying the logarithm function, add a small constant (1e-10) to the MEANJZH column to avoid infinity. The Min-Max normalization needs to transform the TOTUSJZ values to the range 0 to 1.
Return 4 values: @clean_entries[Number of entries after cleaning duplicates], @mean_USFLUX[Mean of the USFLUX column after filling missing values, rounded to two decimal places], @log_MEANJZH[First entry of transformed MEANJZH column, rounded to three decimal places], @norm_TOTUSJZ[First entry of normalized TOTUSJZ column, rounded to three decimal places].

log_MEANJZH.source_excerpt: @log_MEANJZH[First entry of transformed MEANJZH column, rounded to three decimal places]

mean_USFLUX.source_excerpt: @mean_USFLUX[Mean of the USFLUX column after filling missing values, rounded to two decimal places]

norm_TOTUSJZ.source_excerpt: @norm_TOTUSJZ[First entry of normalized TOTUSJZ column, rounded to three decimal places]

trace.sql:
WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT * FROM data
), meanval AS (
  SELECT AVG(USFLUX) AS m FROM dedup WHERE USFLUX IS NOT NULL
), filled2 AS (
  SELECT d.*, COALESCE(d.USFLUX, (SELECT m FROM meanval)) AS USFLUX_f FROM dedup d
), norm AS (
  SELECT MIN(TOTUSJZ) AS mn, MAX(TOTUSJZ) AS mx FROM filled2
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dedup) AS clean_entries,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(USFLUX_f),2) FROM filled2) AS mean_USFLUX,
  (SELECT MEANJZH FROM filled2 LIMIT 1) AS first_meanjzh,
  (SELECT TOTUSJZ FROM filled2 LIMIT 1) AS first_totusjz,
  (SELECT mn FROM norm) AS totusjz_min,
  (SELECT mx FROM norm) AS totusjz_max,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data WHERE USFLUX IS NULL) AS null_usflux

WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT * FROM data
), norm AS (
  SELECT MIN(TOTUSJZ) AS mn, MAX(TOTUSJZ) AS mx FROM dedup
)
SELECT
  (SELECT ROUND(LOG10(MEANJZH + 1e-10),3) FROM dedup LIMIT 1) AS log_MEANJZH,
  (SELECT ROUND((d.TOTUSJZ - norm.mn)/(norm.mx - norm.mn),3) FROM dedup d, norm LIMIT 1) AS norm_TOTUSJZ

task_contract.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
task_contract.public_requirements: Increase or Decrease = consumption for 2013 - consumption for 2012; Percentage of Increase = (Increase or Decrease / consumption for 2013) * 100%; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year

results.final_sql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.Consumption END) AS eur_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption END) AS eur_2013
  FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID=y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency='EUR' AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, eur_2013 - eur_2012 AS increase, 1.0*(eur_2013 - eur_2012)/NULLIF(eur_2013,0)*100 AS pct
FROM p
ORDER BY pct DESC

task_contract.question: For patient born between 1936-1956, how many male patients have creatinine phosphokinase beyond the normal range?
task_contract.public_requirements: born between 1936-1956 refers to year(Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'; male patients refers to sex = 'M'; creatinine phosphokinase beyond the normal range refers to CPK > = 250; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;

results.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS answer
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1936 AND 1956
  AND l.CPK >= 250

task_contract.question: Of the schools that offers a magnet program serving a grade span of Kindergarten to 8th grade, how many offers Multiple Provision Types? List the number of cities that offers a Kindergarten to 8th grade span and indicate how many schools are there serving such grade span for each city.

results.final_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.City, s.GSserved, f."NSLP Provision Status" AS nslp
  FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
),
mpt AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS c FROM base WHERE nslp = 'Multiple Provision Types'
),
per_city AS (
  SELECT City, COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS schools FROM base GROUP BY City
)
SELECT (SELECT c FROM mpt) AS multiple_provision_types_schools,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_city) AS number_of_cities,
       (SELECT group_concat(City || ': ' || schools, '; ') FROM per_city) AS cities_and_schools

task_contract.question: What was the difference in gas consumption between CZK-paying customers and EUR-paying customers in 2012?

  SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS answer

JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012'

trace.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(age), AVG(bmi), AVG(charges) FROM data WHERE age IS NOT NULL AND bmi IS NOT NULL AND charges IS NOT NULL

WITH s AS (
  SELECT age, bmi, charges, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY rowid) - 1 AS rn
  FROM data WHERE age IS NOT NULL AND bmi IS NOT NULL AND charges IS NOT NULL
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT CAST(MAX(rn) AS INTEGER) AS n FROM s
),
-- training set = rn < n*0.8  (first floor(0.8n))
train AS (
  SELECT s.age, s.bmi, s.charges FROM s, bounds WHERE s.rn < bounds.n*0.8
),
test AS (
  SELECT s.age, s.bmi, s.charges FROM s, bounds WHERE s.rn >= bounds.n*0.8
),
tm AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(age) AS ax, AVG(bmi) AS bx, AVG(charges) AS y
  FROM train
),
-- centered sums for OLS with intercept, two predictors
cs AS (
  SELECT SUM((t.age-tm.ax)*(t.age-tm.ax)) AS Sxx,
         SUM((t.bmi-tm.bx)*(t.bmi-tm.bx)) AS Szz,
         SUM((t.age-tm.ax)*(t.bmi-tm.bx)) AS Sxz,
         SUM((t.age-tm.ax)*(t.charges-tm.y)) AS Sxy,
         SUM((t.bmi-tm.bx)*(t.charges-tm.y)) AS Szy
  FROM train t, tm
),
coef AS (
  SELECT
    (Sxy*Szz - Szy*Sxz) / (Sxx*Szz - Sxz*Sxz) AS b_age,
    (Szy*Sxx - Sxy*Sxz) / (Sxx*Szz - Sxz*Sxz) AS b_bmi,
    tm.y AS ybar, tm.ax AS ax, tm.bx AS bx
  FROM cs, tm
),
pred AS (
  SELECT te.charges AS yt,
         (coef.ybar + coef.b_age*(te.age-coef.ax) + coef.b_bmi*(te.bmi-coef.bx)) AS yp
  FROM test te, coef
)
SELECT SQRT(AVG((yt-yp)*(yt-yp))) AS rmse, COUNT(*) AS ntest FROM pred

WITH s AS (
  SELECT age, bmi, charges, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY rowid) - 1 AS rn
  FROM data WHERE age IS NOT NULL AND bmi IS NOT NULL AND charges IS NOT NULL
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT CAST(MAX(rn) AS INTEGER) AS n FROM s
),
train AS (
  SELECT s.age, s.bmi, s.charges FROM s, bounds WHERE s.rn < bounds.n*0.8
),
test AS (
  SELECT s.age, s.bmi, s.charges FROM s, bounds WHERE s.rn >= bounds.n*0.8
),
tm AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(age) AS ax, AVG(bmi) AS bx, AVG(charges) AS y
  FROM train
),
cs AS (
  SELECT SUM((t.age-tm.ax)*(t.age-tm.ax)) AS Sxx,
         SUM((t.bmi-tm.bx)*(t.bmi-tm.bx)) AS Szz,
         SUM((t.age-tm.ax)*(t.bmi-tm.bx)) AS Sxz,
         SUM((t.age-tm.ax)*(t.charges-tm.y)) AS Sxy,
         SUM((t.bmi-tm.bx)*(t.charges-tm.y)) AS Szy
  FROM train t, tm
),
coef AS (
  SELECT
    (Sxy*Szz - Szy*Sxz) / (Sxx*Szz - Sxz*Sxz) AS b_age,
    (Szy*Sxx - Sxy*Sxz) / (Sxx*Szz - Sxz*Sxz) AS b_bmi,
    tm.y AS ybar, tm.ax AS ax, tm.bx AS bx
  FROM cs, tm
),
pred AS (
  SELECT te.charges AS yt,
         (coef.ybar + coef.b_age*(te.age-coef.ax) + coef.b_bmi*(te.bmi-coef.bx)) AS yp
  FROM test te, coef
)
SELECT SQRT(AVG((yt-yp)*(yt-yp))) AS model_rmse FROM pred

  FROM data WHERE "No. of deaths_max" IS NOT NULL
),
q AS (
  SELECT Country,
    MIN(CASE WHEN rn = CAST((cnt+3)/4 AS INT) + (cnt%4=0 AND 0) THEN v END) AS dummy
  FROM ranked GROUP BY Country

SELECT 1

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT Country, "No. of deaths_max" AS v,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Country ORDER BY "No. of deaths_max") - 1 AS pos,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) - 1 AS n1
  FROM data WHERE "No. of deaths_max" IS NOT NULL
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Country, pos, n1, v,
    0.25*n1 AS p25, 0.75*n1 AS p75
  FROM ranked
),
q AS (
  SELECT Country,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pos = CAST(FLOOR(p25) AS INT) THEN v*(CAST(FLOOR(p25) AS INT)+1-p25) END) +
    SUM(CASE WHEN pos = CAST(CEIL(p25) AS INT) AND CEIL(p25)!=FLOOR(p25) THEN v*(p25-CAST(FLOOR(p25) AS INT)) END) AS q1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pos = CAST(FLOOR(p75) AS INT) THEN v*(CAST(FLOOR(p75) AS INT)+1-p75) END) +

  FROM pct GROUP BY Country
),
bounds AS (

),
flagged AS (

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gdpPercap_1982) - 1 AS i0,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM data WHERE gdpPercap_1982 IS NOT NULL
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT v FROM ranked WHERE i0 = (n-1)/2) AS q1,
    (SELECT v FROM ranked WHERE i0 = (n)/2) AS q3,
    (SELECT MAX(n) FROM ranked) AS n
)
SELECT * FROM bounds

    -- Q1 = median of lower 16 (indices 0..15): avg of idx7, idx8
    (SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN i0=7 THEN v END)+MAX(CASE WHEN i0=8 THEN v END))/2.0 FROM ranked) AS q1,
    -- Q3 = median of upper 16 (indices 17..32): avg of idx24, idx25
    (SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN i0=24 THEN v END)+MAX(CASE WHEN i0=25 THEN v END))/2.0 FROM ranked) AS q3
)

task_contract.question: Perform comprehensive data preprocessing on the abalone dataset. Handle any missing values and scale the variables (length, diameter, height, whole weight, shucked weight, viscera weight, shell weight) using min-max normalization. Then, perform a distribution analysis to determine if the scaled variables adhere to a normal distribution.

trace.sql:
WITH cols AS (
 SELECT 'Length' name, Length v FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Diameter', Diameter FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Height', Height FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Whole weight', "Whole weight" FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Shucked weight', "Shucked weight" FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Viscera weight', "Viscera weight" FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Shell weight', "Shell weight" FROM data
), s AS (
 SELECT name, v,
   (v - min(v) OVER (PARTITION BY name))/(max(v) OVER (PARTITION BY name)-min(v) OVER (PARTITION BY name)) z
 FROM cols
), g AS (
 SELECT name,
   avg(z) m, 
   avg(z*z*z) m3,
   avg(z*z*z*z) m4,
   sqrt((avg(z*z)-avg(z)*avg(z))*count(*)/(count(*)-1.0)) sd
 FROM s GROUP BY name
), sk AS (
 SELECT name,
   ((count(*)*1.0)/((count(*)-1.0)*(count(*)-2.0)))*
   (SELECT sum(power(z - m,3)) FROM s WHERE s.name=g.name)/(power(sd,3)) skew
 FROM g
)
SELECT name, skew FROM sk

WITH cols AS (
 SELECT 'Length' name, Length v FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Diameter', Diameter FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Height', Height FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Whole weight', "Whole weight" FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Shucked weight', "Shucked weight" FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Viscera weight', "Viscera weight" FROM data UNION ALL
 SELECT 'Shell weight', "Shell weight" FROM data
), s AS (
 SELECT name, v,
   (v - min(v) OVER (PARTITION BY name))/(max(v) OVER (PARTITION BY name)-min(v) OVER (PARTITION BY name)) z
 FROM cols
), g AS (
 SELECT name, count(*) n, avg(z) m, avg(z*z) m2 FROM s GROUP BY name
), dev AS (
 SELECT s.name, g.n, g.m, g.m2, s.z - g.m dz FROM s JOIN g ON s.name=g.name
), agg AS (
 SELECT name, n, m, m2, sum(dz*dz*dz) s3, sum(dz*dz*dz*dz) s4 FROM dev GROUP BY name
), sk AS (
 SELECT name, n, m, m2, s3, s4, (n/((n-1.0)*(n-2.0)))*s3/power(sqrt((m2-m*m)*n/(n-1.0)),3) skew FROM agg
)
SELECT name, skew,
  ((n*(n+1.0))/((n-1.0)*(n-2.0)*(n-3.0)))*s4/power(sqrt((m2-m*m)*n/(n-1.0)),4)
  - 3.0*(n-1.0)*(n-1.0)/((n-2.0)*(n-3.0)) AS kurt
FROM sk

WITH q AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(MedInc) AS mn, MAX(MedInc) AS mx
  FROM data
), ranked AS (
  SELECT MedInc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MedInc) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM data
), quart AS (
  SELECT
    -- Q1 and Q3 via linear interpolation (numpy default)
    (SELECT MedInc FROM ranked WHERE rn = CAST((n-1)*0.25 AS INT)+1) AS q1lo,
    (SELECT MedInc FROM ranked WHERE rn = CAST((n-1)*0.25 AS INT)+2) AS q1hi,
    ((n-1)*0.25 - CAST((n-1)*0.25 AS INT)) AS q1f,
    (SELECT MedInc FROM ranked WHERE rn = CAST((n-1)*0.75 AS INT)+1) AS q3lo,
    (SELECT MedInc FROM ranked WHERE rn = CAST((n-1)*0.75 AS INT)+2) AS q3hi,
    ((n-1)*0.75 - CAST((n-1)*0.75 AS INT)) AS q3f
  FROM ranked LIMIT 1
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    q1lo + q1f*(q1hi-q1lo) AS q1,
    q3lo + q3f*(q3hi-q3lo) AS q3
  FROM quart
), iqr AS (
  SELECT q1, q3, (q3-q1) AS iqr FROM bounds
), cleaned AS (
  SELECT d.MedInc
  FROM data d, iqr
  WHERE d.MedInc >= iqr.q1 - 1.5*iqr.iqr AND d.MedInc <= iqr.q3 + 1.5*iqr.iqr
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(MedInc),2) AS mean,
       ROUND(SQRT(SUM((MedInc - (SELECT AVG(MedInc) FROM cleaned))*(MedInc - (SELECT AVG(MedInc) FROM cleaned)))/(COUNT(*)-1)),2) AS standard_deviation
FROM cleaned

task_contract.question: 2. Are there any outliers in the age distribution of offenders in 'Assault' category, according to the IQR method? If yes, report the number of outliers.
task_contract.public_requirements:
You are to use the Interquartile Range (IQR) method for outlier detection. Calculate the IQR as Q3 (75th percentile) - Q1 (25th percentile) for the 'Assault' category. Outliers are considered as values lying below Q1 - 1.5 * IQR or above Q3 + 1.5 * IQR.
@number_of_outliers[number] where "number" is a positive integer denoting the number of outliers

number_of_outliers.source_excerpt: where "number" is a positive integer denoting the number of outliers

trace.sql:
SELECT 'Category' AS f, Category AS v, COUNT(*) FROM data WHERE Category LIKE '%Assault%' GROUP BY Category
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Offense', Offense, COUNT(*) FROM data WHERE Offense LIKE '%Assault%' GROUP BY Offense

WITH x AS (
  SELECT Age FROM data WHERE Offense LIKE '%Assault%' AND Age IS NOT NULL
),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM x),
ranked AS (SELECT Age, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Age) - 1 AS rn FROM x),
q AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT cnt FROM n) AS cnt,
    (SELECT AVG(Age) FROM ranked WHERE rn IN (CAST((cnt-1)*0.25 AS INT), CAST((cnt-1)*0.25 AS INT)+1) )
      AS dummy
  FROM n
)
SELECT cnt, 
  (SELECT Age FROM ranked WHERE rn = CAST((cnt-1)*0.25 AS INT)) AS q1_lo,
  (SELECT Age FROM ranked WHERE rn = CAST((cnt-1)*0.25 AS INT)+1) AS q1_hi,
  (cnt-1)*0.25 AS q1_h,
  (cnt-1)*0.75 AS q3_h
FROM q

WITH x AS (
  SELECT Age FROM data WHERE Offense LIKE '%Assault%' AND Age IS NOT NULL
),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM x),
ranked AS (SELECT Age, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Age) - 1 AS rn FROM x),
q AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT Age FROM ranked r WHERE r.rn = CAST((cnt-1)*0.25 AS INT)) AS q1,
    (SELECT Age FROM ranked r WHERE r.rn = CAST((cnt-1)*0.75 AS INT)) AS q3,
    cnt
  FROM n
),
f AS (SELECT q1, q3, q3-q1 AS iqr, q1-1.5*(q3-q1) AS lo, q3+1.5*(q3-q1) AS hi FROM q)
SELECT f.q1, f.q3, f.iqr, f.lo, f.hi,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM x WHERE Age < f.lo OR Age > f.hi) AS outliers
FROM f

WITH x AS (
  SELECT Age FROM data WHERE Offense LIKE '%Assault%' AND Age IS NOT NULL
),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM x),
ranked AS (SELECT Age, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Age) - 1 AS rn FROM x),
q AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT Age FROM ranked r WHERE r.rn = CAST((cnt-1)*0.25 AS INT)) AS q1,
    (SELECT Age FROM ranked r WHERE r.rn = CAST((cnt-1)*0.75 AS INT)) AS q3
  FROM n
),
f AS (SELECT q1, q3, q1-1.5*(q3-q1) AS lo, q3+1.5*(q3-q1) AS hi FROM q)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM x WHERE Age < f.lo OR Age > f.hi) AS number_of_outliers
FROM f

task_contract.question:
Perform comprehensive data preprocessing for the dataset by:
1. Removing any duplicate entries.
2. Filling in missing values in the USFLUX column with the mean value of the column.
3. Transforming the MEANJZH column by applying the logarithm function (base 10).
4. Normalizing the TOTUSJZ column using Min-Max normalization.
task_contract.public_requirements:
When applying the logarithm function, add a small constant (1e-10) to the MEANJZH column to avoid infinity. The Min-Max normalization needs to transform the TOTUSJZ values to the range 0 to 1.
Return 4 values: @clean_entries[Number of entries after cleaning duplicates], @mean_USFLUX[Mean of the USFLUX column after filling missing values, rounded to two decimal places], @log_MEANJZH[First entry of transformed MEANJZH column, rounded to three decimal places], @norm_TOTUSJZ[First entry of normalized TOTUSJZ column, rounded to three decimal places].

WITH d AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM data),
f AS (SELECT *, (SELECT AVG(USFLUX) FROM d WHERE USFLUX IS NOT NULL) AS m FROM d),
filled AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(USFLUX, m) AS u FROM f),
mm AS (SELECT MIN(TOTUSJZ) AS mn, MAX(TOTUSJZ) AS mx FROM filled)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS clean_entries,
       ROUND(AVG(u), 2) AS mean_USFLUX,
       (SELECT ROUND(LOG10(MEANJZH + 1e-10), 3) FROM filled ORDER BY TRUE_TIME, TIME LIMIT 1) AS log_MEANJZH,
       (SELECT ROUND((TOTUSJZ - mn) / (mx - mn), 3) FROM filled, mm ORDER BY TRUE_TIME, TIME LIMIT 1) AS norm_TOTUSJZ
FROM filled

task_contract.question: List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respective counties based on average reading scores.
task_contract.public_requirements: Exclusively virtual refers to Virtual = 'F'; respective counties means PARTITION BY County

results.final_sql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.County, t.AvgScrRead
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
    AND t.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
), r AS (
  SELECT School, County, AvgScrRead,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY County ORDER BY AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
  FROM v
)
SELECT School FROM r WHERE rnk <= 5 ORDER BY County, School

task_contract.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
task_contract.public_requirements: Increase or Decrease = consumption for 2013 - consumption for 2012; Percentage of Increase = (Increase or Decrease / consumption for 2013) * 100%; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year

results.final_sql:
SELECT c.Segment,
 SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.Consumption END) AS cons_2012,
 SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption END) AS cons_2013,
 ROUND(1.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption END)-SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.Consumption END))/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption END),0)*100,2) AS pct_increase
FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID=y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency='EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM') AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

 SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.Consumption END) AS cons_2012,

 ROUND(1.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption END)-SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.Consumption END))/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption END),0)*100,2) AS pct_increase

task_contract.question: For loans contracts which are still running where client are in debt, list the district of the and the state the percentage unemployment rate increment from year 1995 to 1996.
